digest.component_or_area: code review workflow — carry-forward across patchsets
propositions: Code review findings raised on one patchset but not re-emitted on the next fail to reach consumers because payloads are keyed by (change_id, revision) and only latest findings are read.

Prior surfaced findings (blocking + advisory buckets only) must be classified into immutable states (still-present, addressed, withdrawn) based on whether the cited file hash matches the prior review, and re-injected if still-present and absent from fresh Pass-1 output.

A carried finding is stamped with standing.state, standing.origin_revision, and standing.origin_decision (derived from the prior surfaced bucket, never inventing a blocking posture), and the posture is clamped to at most the origin decision.
Carry-forward is one-shot: an already-carried item (one that previously carried a standing object) is classified withdrawn and not carried again, terminating the chain after one patchset.

Resolution happens pre-workflow in gate_dispatch._assemble_code_review_run where both session_id and change_id are available; carried items are threaded as a new optional standing_findings input and merged post-Pass-1 by workflow_ops.merge_findings.
Gerrit text and the reviewer prompt must mark carried findings with 'since patchset' and 'standing finding' or 'carried from an earlier patchset' to distinguish them from fresh findings.
